name: Navigation Collapse
principle: Navigation represents human responsibilities, not backend entities.

canonicalDestinations.label: Work
canonicalDestinations.question: What can I work on now?

canonicalDestinations.label: Network
canonicalDestinations.question: Who and what is connected to my work?

canonicalDestinations.label: People
canonicalDestinations.question: Who is involved and what responsibility/access do they have?

canonicalDestinations.label: Account
canonicalDestinations.question: Who am I and what governs my account?

rules: The authenticated application exposes one canonical six-destination Human Work navigation model.
Product presentation may relabel destinations but cannot remove the canonical human navigation destinations.
Legacy human-facing hashes resolve to canonical destinations and remain compatibility bridges until Wave 6.
Context remains entered from Work or contextual surfaces and is not promoted to a seventh top-level destination.
Control Plane navigation remains separate and is never merged into Operations Plane navigation.
Navigation is presentation-only; domain authorities, authorization and canonical Action execution remain unchanged.
